rationale: Ahmad brings deep expertise in AI-native hardware design across computer vision, spatial computing, and hand-tracking (Vision Pro, Leap Motion, Neuralink), while Sidra has core ML engineering skills in PyTorch and TensorFlow that are essential for integrating generative AI models into novel hardware form factors. Given Ahmad's explicit conviction that next-gen AI hardware must be deeply integrated with AI models rather than bolt-on, Sidra's machine learning foundation could complement hardware-software integration work at the intersection of their interests.
intro_message: Ahmad Abbas, meet Sidra Miconi — Ahmad leads hardware for AI-native devices at Midjourney and has shipped spatial computing systems; Sidra is a machine learning engineer in SF, and you two might explore how ML and hardware design intersect in next-gen AI devices.
